versions.changelog: Remove token/credential references, add security section, reframe as product overview

Initial release of PageClaw Setup.

- Enables guided Facebook Page integration with OpenClaw agents for 9 business types.
- Loads 37 specialized AI skills (auto-reply, bookings, reviews, analytics, and more) based on business category.
- Simple 3-step Quick Start and manual setup options provided.
- Built and supported by OneChat.ai, a Meta Business Partner.
- No need for a Meta app—secure integration via the PageClaw platform.
